changes.comment: Add `daemon.backgroundPrepare` (or `RUSH_DAEMON_BACKGROUND_PREPARE=1`), an experimental Rush daemon setting that is off by default. With it, when a watched workspace input changes so that the next request would reload the workspace graph, an idle daemon reloads it and creates the engine for the command line of the last phased command that it served, so that the next request with that command line starts on the new generation.
